title: Unary tape symbol in a macrostep configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over the schedule alphabet, and let $c$ be a schedule-controller configuration on $x$. For any optional phase $q$ and integers $u,g$, the symbol scanned on the unary-counter tape of the macrostep configuration built from $c$ at head position $u$ is the content of $c$'s unary-counter tape at position $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a word over the schedule alphabet
replaced:
In every macrostep configuration with unary head at $u$, the symbol read on the unary
tape is the base configuration's unary tape content at coordinate $u$.
